Thank you.

Sent from Yahoo Mail for iPhone

Hi Michael,

You're welcome. Nothing more needed from you on the screen, it goes out from the warehouse on Shop···· and the tracking lands in your inbox as soon as it ships. Just remember the flash at harlolabs.com once it's fitted.

Your Magic Miner 40T is still set for October 31, with the Duster and Power Kit in the box.

It was a pleasure sorting this out for you. If you were happy with how we handled it, a word on Trustpilot would mean a lot to us: https://www.trustpilot.com/review/heliumdeploy.com

You're also very welcome in our Discord for new product news and hands-on help: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf

Thanks again, and enjoy the rig.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

The B.04 is fine with me. I like the one I have already. Thank youMatthew S.

Sent from Yahoo Mail for iPhone
Handed to the team · Customer confirmation on Georges' replacement offer, needs logging against the R

Hi Matthew,

That's great, the BC04 is locked in for you. It's set aside at our US warehouse and goes out as soon as your NerdQaxe++ reaches us in Chattanooga, at no cost to you.

All that's left on your side is the return. Pack the NerdQaxe++ securely, write Shop···· on the outside of the box, stick on the prepaid USPS label Georges sent, and drop it at any USPS counter. Tracking on that return is (number hidden), and you'll get the tracking for the BC04 by email once it ships.

I've noted your confirmation on the file so nothing gets held up. Georges is back on at 10am ET today and will see it there.

Thanks for being easy to work with on this, Matthew.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

I try to be easy to work with. I also know that things happen and can get lost in translation when dealing with with customers. I had my share of dealing with customers when I was a recruiter for the Marines 20 years ago. Here is a picture of me back in 2007.

Thank youMatthew S.

Sent from Yahoo Mail for iPhone

Hi Matthew,

That's a great photo, thank you for sharing it. Marine Corps dress blues in the Oval Office is not something most people have on the wall, and twenty years on a recruiting desk explains why you are so easy to deal with. Thank you for your service.

Nothing else needed from you right now. Drop the NerdQaxe++ at USPS with the prepaid label when it suits you, and the BC04 goes out from Chattanooga as soon as it lands. Your screen and the 40T are both tracked on our side too.

Anything at all comes up, just reply here.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hello, the BSB NerdQAxe++ 6th is now at the post office on its way to you. With the order number Shop···· all over the box.Thank youMatthew S.

Sent from Yahoo Mail for iPhone
Handed to the team · Return is in transit, reserved BC04 needs releasing when it checks in at Chattan

Hi Matthew,

Perfect, thank you for getting that out so quickly. I've noted the return as in transit against Shop····, tracking ····, so the warehouse in Chattanooga knows to expect it.

Your Hammer BC04 is already set aside and goes out as soon as the return checks in. The tracking for it comes to this address automatically.

Nothing else needed from you. Your replacement screen and the Magic Miner 40T are both still tracked on our side.

Thanks again, Matthew.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
